name: Eye Dropper
summary: Captures a color from the page or anywhere on screen with a keyboard shortcut, copies it in multiple formats, and keeps palettes and pick history.
browsersNote: AMO and the Edge store have same-name listings by other authors; neither was confirmed as this project on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Grabbing a color from anywhere on screen with a keyboard shortcut.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: color picker eyedropper keyboard shortcut palette history
